episodeTitle.zh: 创始人背后的故事：马克·贝尼奥夫

guestBioOfficial.en: Marc Benioff is the co-founder and CEO of Salesforce, the second-largest software company in the world. He started programming at age 15, selling his first program for $75, and went on to build Salesforce into a company worth more than $300 billion that also owns Slack, Tableau, Quip, and MuleSoft. Marc is known as a marketing legend, and is now leading Salesforce into the era of AI agents. In our conversation, we discuss: • The importance of maintaining a beginner’s mind
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马克·贝尼奥夫是Salesforce的联合创始人兼CEO，Salesforce是全球第二大软件公司。他15岁开始编程，首次出售程序时售价75美元，后来将Salesforce打造为市值超3000亿美元的公司，旗下还拥有Slack、Tableau、Quip和MuleSoft等产品。马克被誉为营销传奇人物，如今正引领Salesforce迈入AI智能助手时代。在对话中，我们将探讨：•保持初学者心态的重要性

title.zh: 创始人背后的故事：马克·贝尼奥夫

summary.en: Marc shares his philosophy of compassionate, stakeholder-centered capitalism and how Salesforce pioneered cloud software and the "1-1-1" philanthropy model. He discusses leading through massive scale, the role of trust as the #1 value, and how to keep innovating as a large company. The episode is a rare look at building and running an enduring tech institution.
summary.zh: 马克分享了他"以人为本、兼顾各方利益相关者"的资本主义理念，以及 Salesforce 如何开创云软件与"1-1-1"慈善模式。他探讨了在巨大规模下如何领导、为何把"信任"作为第一价值观，以及大公司如何持续创新。本期罕见地展示了如何构建并运营一家经久不衰的科技机构。
